editorial.blurb: Dhanteraz brings authentic Indian flavors and genuine warmth to Roscoe Village, where every dish tastes like it's made with love and the team treats you like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the spicy garlic naan and ask your server (like Kavya) for recommendations—the kitchen respects spice levels 1-10 precisely, and they'll help you celebrate any occasion with thoughtful gestures like their signature mango tres leches cake.
